username.title: Change Username
username.subtitle:
You can change your username that is displayed in the app.
This will not affect your login credentials.
username.information:
You can change username by editing this field and saving changes.
Make sure to choose a unique username that is not already taken by another user.

You can change your username once per month

success.title: Username changed successfully
success.content:
Your username has been changed successfully.
We wish you a great time watching your favorite animes!

error.title: Username change failed

logout.title: Log Out
logout.subtitle: You can log out of your account by using this button. This will require you to log back in to the app.

modal.title: Are you sure you want to log out?
modal.content: Logging out will require you to log back in to the app.
